title: Markov maps and quasi-conformal deformations associated to geometrically finite Kleinian groups
summary: It is known that the dynamical properties of Kleinian groups with parabolic elements are much more complex than those without parabolic elements. In this paper, we mainly study the quasi-conformal deformation properties of geometrically finite Kleinian groups with parabolic elements. We show that, for a Kleinian group $G$ with parabolic elements, there exists a subset $K$ of the limit set $Λ(G)$ such that the first return map $f_{K}$ is (eventually) expending.
